# Badge Status

A non-interactive workflow status label with consistent colors and translated text.

## Usage

```ts
import { BadgeStatus } from '$lib/io/badge-status';
```

Set `status` to a workflow status to select its translated label and color.
`text` overrides the label, and numeric `count` values are locale-formatted.

Paused adds an implied pause extension. Set `showImpliedExtensions={false}` to
omit implied extensions. Custom `extensions` follow them. Truncation is enabled
by default; constrain the parent width to see it.

## API Reference

| Name                  | Description                                                                                                                              | Type                                                                                                               | Default | Required |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- | -------- |
| status                |                                                                                                                                          | `"Running" \| "Paused" \| "Completed" \| "ContinuedAsNew" \| "Failed" \| "TimedOut" \| "Terminated" \| "Canceled"` | —       | Yes      |
| size                  |                                                                                                                                          | `"sm" \| "md"`                                                                                                     | `"md"`  | No       |
| truncate              |                                                                                                                                          | `boolean`                                                                                                          | `true`  | No       |
| text                  |                                                                                                                                          | `string`                                                                                                           | —       | No       |
| count                 |                                                                                                                                          | `string \| number`                                                                                                 | —       | No       |
| TrailIcon             |                                                                                                                                          | `false \| IconComponent`                                                                                           | —       | No       |
| showImpliedExtensions | some statuses such as 'Paused' imply an extension (a pause icon)<br />this is an escape hatch for when you do not want those extensions. | `boolean`                                                                                                          | `true`  | No       |
| extensions            |                                                                                                                                          | `false \| BadgeExtensions`                                                                                         | —       | No       |
